default/30959.htm.text: Musician Barbado: Welcome, you fresh-faced traveller! I am a musician, an artisan of melodies. Music is the finest blessing bestowed upon us by Eva, the goddess of art. When your feeling blue, as I sometimes do, nothing cheers you up like a cheerful tune played on the accordian! It will lighten the…

Q00363_SorrowfulSoundOfFlute/30959-01.ht.text: Musician Barbado: Just what I've always wanted! I wish I knew who sent me this! Whoever it is must know me well.

Q00363_SorrowfulSoundOfFlute/30959-02.ht.text: Musician Barbado: Thanks anyway, but I don't have any use for that. If that is all, would you excuse me, please? I must practice my music.

Q00363_SorrowfulSoundOfFlute/30959-03.ht.text: Musician Barbado: I am practicing my music. Please don't disturb me.

Q00364_JovialAccordion/30959-01.htm.text: Musician Barbado: Some time ago, I heard Bard Swan playing his mandolin. His skills are quite impressive. I wish he would play a duet with me, but for some reason, whenever he sees me he avoids me... I hate to ask you to do this, but would you go see Swan and tell him that I want to play a duet wit…

Q00364_JovialAccordion/30959-04.html.text: Musician Barbado: You must persuade Bard Swan to play music with me. You will find him under the big tree in the center of the village. I am sure you are capable of this.

Q00364_JovialAccordion/30959-05.html.text: Musician Barbado: Thank you so much! At last I get to play a duet with Bard Swan! My dream is coming true! You have made this possible. Here! Take this priceless accordion music as a token of my appreciation!

Q00364_JovialAccordion/30959-02.htm.text: Musician Barbado: Thank you so much! You can find Bard Swan beneath the big tree in the center of the village. Please convince him to honor my request. I am sure you are capable of this.

Q00364_JovialAccordion/30959-03.htm.text: Musician Barbado: Thank you for offering, but I am afraid that you lack the necessary skills to undertake this task. It will be too much for you. (This quest can be undertaken only by a character of level 15 or above.)
